title: Backcasting from Cyber AI Governance That Keeps Pace With Capability: What Institutional Velocity Is Required?

original_idea.body:
# Backcasting from Cyber AI Governance That Keeps Pace With Capability: What Institutional Velocity Is Required?

**Problem:** Kraprayoon et al. argue the governance window is narrowing. Working backward from governance that keeps pace with capability development identifies what institutional update speed must be achieved.

**Direction:** Estimate the current AI capability update cycle (quarterly major model releases). Estimate current governance update cycle (RSP major revisions: approximately annual). Compute the ratio. Model what institutional change (pre-negotiated trigger criteria, standing update committees, automated benchmark-triggered review) would close the velocity gap.

**Why it matters:** If governance cannot structurally match capability update velocity, the governance window will close regardless of framework quality. Institutional velocity is the binding constraint.

**Relevant context:** Kraprayoon HACCA governance window; Bengio et al. pace mismatch; Anthropic RSP update history.
